install.q: Do I need to install any software?
install.a: No. Plenton runs entirely in the browser on any device with internet access.

trial.q: How does the free period work?
trial.a: You have 14 days to use the platform at no cost and without adding a credit card. At the end, you decide whether to subscribe.

security.q: Are my data and my patients' data secure?
security.a: Yes. All data is isolated by account, encrypted in transit, and stored in secure infrastructure.

patientAccess.a: Patients can receive public links, such as anamneses, without an account. A dedicated patient app is also planned.

cancel.a: Yes. There is no lock-in. Cancellation is completed in the platform and access remains available until the end of the paid cycle.

taco.q: Does Plenton include the TACO catalog?
taco.a: Yes. The official Brazilian food composition database is already imported and available for meal plans.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How {{appName}} processes and protects personal data on the platform.
privacy.disclaimer: This document is an initial template and must be reviewed by legal counsel before taking effect so it accurately reflects actual data-processing practices and applicable law.
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters to us. This document transparently describes how {{appName}} collects, uses, shares, and protects personal data processed on the platform.

about.heading: Who we are
about.p1: {{appName}} is a management platform for nutrition professionals that brings patient records, meal plans, anamneses, scheduling, and indicators together. This Privacy Policy explains how we process the personal data of platform users and their patients.
about.p2: By creating an account or using the platform, you acknowledge the practices described in this document.

collected.heading: Data we collect
collected.intro: We collect different categories of data according to your interaction with the platform:
collected.b1: User registration data: name, email, phone, professional identification, and access credentials.
collected.b2: Subscription and payment data: plan, subscription status, and billing identifiers. We do not store complete credit-card data.
collected.b3: Patient data entered by users: identification, contact, clinical and anthropometric data, anamneses, meal plans, and care records.
collected.b4: Usage and technical data: IP address, device, browser, pages accessed, dates, times, and activity logs.
collected.b5: Cookies and similar technologies required for authentication, preferences, and experience improvements.

purpose.heading: How we use data
purpose.intro: We use personal data for the following purposes, supported by a lawful basis under Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD):
purpose.b1: Enable registration, authentication, and account operation.
purpose.b2: Provide and operate platform resources such as patients, meal plans, anamneses, and scheduling.
purpose.b5: Maintain security, prevent fraud, and comply with legal obligations.
purpose.b6: Improve the platform using aggregated usage data.

patients.heading: Processing patient data
patients.p1: For patient data, the nutrition professional who owns the account acts as controller and is responsible for the appropriate lawful bases. {{appName}} acts as processor and handles this data on behalf of and according to the user's instructions.
patients.p2: Users must ensure they have a lawful basis to enter and process patient data and respond to data-subject requests.

sharing.heading: Data sharing
sharing.intro: We do not sell personal data. We may strictly share data in the following situations:
sharing.b1: Infrastructure and hosting providers responsible for storing and processing platform data.
sharing.b2: Payment providers used to process subscriptions and charges.
sharing.b3: Communication and support providers when needed to assist users.
sharing.b4: Competent authorities when required by law, regulation, or court order.
sharing.p2: Third parties that process data on our behalf are contractually required to adopt security measures and follow our instructions.

cookies.heading: Cookies and tracking technologies
cookies.p1: We use cookies and similar technologies to keep you signed in, remember preferences, and understand platform usage. Essential cookies are required for the service; others can be managed in your browser.

security.heading: Information security
security.p1: We adopt technical and organizational measures such as encryption in transit, account isolation, access controls, and monitoring. No method is completely secure, but we continuously work to reduce risks.

retention.heading: Data retention and deletion
retention.p1: We keep personal data for as long as required for the purposes in this policy, legal obligations, and the exercise of rights. After account closure, data may be deleted or anonymized subject to legal retention periods.

rights.heading: Data-subject rights
rights.intro: Under the LGPD, data subjects may request at any time:
rights.b1: Confirmation of processing and access to their data.
rights.b2: Correction of incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated data.
rights.b3: Anonymization, blocking, or deletion of unnecessary or unlawfully processed data.
rights.b5: Information about sharing with third parties.
rights.contactBefore: To exercise your rights, contact us at
rights.contactAfter: If the data concerns a patient, the request should be directed to the nutrition professional responsible for the account.

changes.heading: Changes to this policy
changes.p1: This Privacy Policy may be updated to reflect legal, technical, or service changes. The latest update is shown at the top of the document.

contact.heading: Data protection contact
contact.before: For questions about this Privacy Policy or personal-data processing, contact us at

platform.heading: Platform description
platform.p1: {{appName}} is a management tool for nutrition professionals with patient records, meal plans, anamneses, scheduling, and indicators. It supports professional work and does not replace qualified professional judgment.

account.heading: Registration and account
account.intro: To use the platform, you must create an account with truthful, accurate, and current information. You are responsible for credential confidentiality and account activity.
account.b1: You must have legal capacity to contract and, where applicable, a valid professional registration.
account.b2: Access is personal and non-transferable; credential sharing is your responsibility.
account.b3: Notify us immediately of unauthorized use or suspected account-security violations.

use.heading: Platform use
use.intro: You agree to use the platform lawfully and according to these terms. You must not:
use.b1: Use the platform for unlawful purposes or to violate third-party rights.
use.b2: Attempt to access areas, data, or accounts that do not belong to you.
use.b3: Reverse engineer, copy, modify, or commercially exploit the platform without authorization.
use.b4: Introduce malicious code or compromise service security or availability.

responsibilities.heading: User responsibilities
responsibilities.intro: You are responsible for data and content entered into the platform, including patient data, and agree to:
responsibilities.b1: Ensure a lawful basis for collecting and processing data under the LGPD.
responsibilities.b2: Obtain consent or another lawful basis for health data where applicable.
responsibilities.b3: Respond to requests from data subjects whose data you control.
responsibilities.b4: Use the platform according to professional rules and applicable law.

plans.heading: Plans, subscriptions, and payments
plans.intro: The platform is offered through free or paid plans. Prices, billing cycles, and features are shown during subscription and may be updated with notice.
plans.b1: Paid subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each cycle unless canceled.
plans.b2: Payments are processed by a third party; failures may suspend access to paid resources.
plans.b3: Price changes will be communicated in advance and apply to the following cycle.

trial.heading: Free trial period
trial.p1: We may offer a free trial. After it ends, paid resources require a subscription. We may change or discontinue trial offers.

cancellation.heading: Cancellation
cancellation.p1: You may cancel through the platform. Cancellation stops future renewals and retains access until the paid cycle ends. Unless required by law, used periods are non-refundable.

intellectual.heading: Intellectual property
intellectual.p1: Rights to the {{appName}} platform, including its brand, software, design, and text, belong to {{appName}} or its licensors. Use does not transfer intellectual property. Your data and content remain yours.

availability.heading: Availability and support
availability.p1: We seek to keep the platform available and secure, but maintenance or outages outside our control may occur. We do not guarantee uninterrupted availability.

liability.heading: Limitation of liability
liability.p1: To the fullest extent permitted by law, {{appName}} is not liable for clinical or professional decisions based on the platform, indirect damages, lost profits, data loss caused by misuse, or user-entered content.

suspension.heading: Account suspension and termination
suspension.p1: We may suspend or terminate accounts for violations, fraud, legal requirements, or nonpayment. You may also close your account subject to Privacy Policy retention rules.

changes.heading: Changes to the terms
changes.p1: These terms may be updated. Material changes will be communicated and the update date shown. Continued use means acceptance of the current terms.

law.heading: Governing law and venue
law.p1: These terms are governed by the laws of the Federative Republic of Brazil. The courts of the user's domicile shall have jurisdiction unless the law provides otherwise.
